en: A monochrome postcard showing an old European city square with a large, ornate Baroque/Neoclassical building dominating the center. The façade has many evenly spaced windows and pilasters, attic statues and a clock or coat of arms at the top. In the square are well‑dressed 19th‑century figures—gentlemen in top hats, ladies in long dresses, soldiers, a rider on horseback, a horse‑drawn carriage, and market stalls with awnings and café tables. On the left edge a richly decorated corner building with arcades frames the scene; in the background a tall church or town‑hall tower rises above a street of narrow houses.
